primary_endpoint: Participants with TEAEs, SAEs, or Grade ≥1 laboratory abnormalities through up to Week 28; and participants discontinuing study drug or study due to adverse events through Week 28.
safety_signal: TEAEs were reported in 17, 15, 9, 9, and 7 participants across the SEL 6 mg, SEL 18 mg, combination, and SIM-only arms, respectively; SAEs affected 2/20, 2/22, 0/10, 1/10, and 0/10. Adverse-event discontinuations were 1, 2, 0, 0, and 0, respectively; no deaths occurred.
